title: 1.7 Parents and Grandparents
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Name the father, the mother, the parents, the grandparents and the grandchildren.
grammar_function: Er/Sie ist der/die + family noun; Sie sind die + plural family noun.
speaking_outcome: Say who the parents and grandparents are.
